name: Upload Size Per Role
description: Change the maximum upload size for each user role.
project_description:
The "Upload Size Per Role" module for Drupal allows site administrators to set specific file upload size limits for different user roles. This provides a way to control the maximum file upload size based on the user's role, ensuring that certain roles have different upload size limits than others.

 With this module, administrators can easily configure and manage the file upload size restrictions for various roles, such as anonymous users, authenticated users, and custom roles. This level of control can be particularly useful for sites with diverse user roles and varying requirements for file uploads.

 By utilizing the "Upload Size Per Role" module, Drupal site administrators can enhance security, optimize resource allocation, and tailor the user experience based on the specific needs and permissions of different roles within the site.

 Ensure the "Maximum upload size" field is empty (no limit) for any overridden field, otherwise, the module will fail.
